name: Three levels of a problem, in clients' own words
useWhen: The same problem appears at three levels of maturity, and each level has a client quote that proves it.

focal.note: The indicator carries the ordering, not size — which is why the level names can stay quiet and let the quotes do the work.

replacesNote: columns-v1 is three parallel columns. This is three rungs, and the squares are the difference.

deviations.why: At top-anchored the cards ended near y=630 and left the lower 40% dead — the failure seq-steps-panels-5 worked through. Centring turns the leftover into balanced margin.
